name: Enshrouded
tagline: Native connector for an Enshrouded dedicated server: one dbghelp.dll next to the server exe.
requirements: File access to the Enshrouded dedicated server folder

assets.label: Plugin
assets.hint: Copy dbghelp.dll and the takaro folder next to enshrouded_server.exe, then paste the registration token into takaro\plugin.json (no restart needed if the server already runs); the zip includes install, upgrade and rollback instructions.
